companyDescription: Quantum computing · Photonic quantum hardware (Dirac systems) and foundry (Luminar Semiconductor acquisition) — $1.4B cash chest funding an aggressive build-out into the 2026 'quantum advantage' narrative
priceNote: Off its June highs (~$8.75) heading into the Aug 10 print, after a volatile summer typical of the quantum-computing group
summary: QUBT reports Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 10 with consensus modeling roughly 7,700%+ YoY revenue growth off a tiny base — the number itself is nearly guaranteed to look spectacular. The real question is guidance: Q1 2026 was a clean beat ($3.7M revenue vs $39K a year earlier) yet shares barely moved because a 36% pre-earnings run-up had already priced it in and management gave no forward outlook. Sector peer Rigetti hit the same wall in May 2026 — beat estimates, still fell -7% same day. QUBT sits on $1.4B in cash with minimal debt, so survival isn't the risk; the risk is another guidance-less 'beat and stall' that leaves the stock exactly where it started. A real leg higher likely needs QUBT's first-ever formal FY guidance or a disclosed commercial contract alongside the print.
